works.noCopies: No copy in this library yet. Add one with “+” next to a release or track it.
works.catalogHint: Catalog data applies to every library and person.
works.releaseHint: Platform, region and edition – as printed on the case.
works.dateHint: As exact as known: day, month, quarter … or TBA.
works.coverHint: Shown in every library unless it has its own cover.
works.barcodeHint: Confirmed barcodes answer future scans instantly.
works.moveReleaseHint: To another game or as a game of its own. Copies come along; nothing else changes in the libraries.

modes.existingHint: e.g. the Complete Edition to the base game.
modes.own: As a game of its own
modes.ownHint: If it's really a different game, e.g. a remake.

works.mergeHint: When two entries are the same game – like the base version and the Complete Edition.
works.mergeMoves: All releases (and so copies) go to the target; this entry disappears. Undo with “Move release”.
works.noCopiesOfRelease: No copy of this release in this library yet.
works.releaseDevelopersHint: Only if another studio worked on this release, e.g. a port or remaster. The game’s developers belong to the game.
works.gameCoverHint: A general cover for the game, e.g. its key art. It shows wherever a release has no cover of its own.
works.noGameCover: No cover of its own – the first release cover shows instead.
works.coverFromGame: No cover of its own – this is the game’s cover.
